subject: Quarter Kickoff: Owners onboarding, OKR alignment, and QBR packet readiness
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha@fjordapps.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quarter Kickoff: Owners onboarding, OKR alignment, and QBR packet readiness

Team —

We kickoff the quarter next week and I want to get ahead on owners onboarding, OKR alignment, and the QBR packet so we don’t have last-minute scramble. Please review the attached draft QBR packet and the OKR rubric and confirm the following by EOD Monday: 

- Owners: Confirm who will own each objective (name + primary metric)
- Measures: Confirm the top 1–2 metrics per objective that will appear in the QBR packet
- Risks & dependencies: List any cross-org blockers we should surface now

Attachments: QBR_packet_v0.3.pptx, okr_rubric_v2.csv, owners_onboarding_agenda.pdf

I’ll schedule a 30-minute owners onboarding on Tuesday 10am PT to lock sections. If you need a different time, say so.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Head of GTM Strategy, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter Kickoff: Owners onboarding, OKR alignment, and QBR packet readiness

Thanks Priya — quick notes after a first pass on the deck: 

- Slide 6 (Revenue by segment): can we split the NRR movement by Dedicated vs Hosted? Ops will want that breakout in the QBR.
- OKR rubric: Suggest we add a short column for "leading indicator" (weekly signal) so owners have a clear early-warning metric.
- Owners: I can take the Dedicated capacity objective but would like to co-own the rollout cadence with Kimberly.

I’ll add comments in the Drive link tonight.

— Jonas
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha@fjordapps.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter Kickoff: Owners onboarding, OKR alignment, and QBR packet readiness

Priya / team —

I reviewed the packet and rubric. A couple of asks from Product/Engineering: 

- For the "Reduce median tail latency" metric, we need to define the measurement spec (percentile, sample window, and traffic signal). I added a short spec to okr_rubric_v2.csv (column: measurement_spec).
- The onboarding agenda looks right. Recommend a short slot for privacy/compliance owners to confirm data retention language (5 minutes).

I attached the updated okr_rubric_v2.csv with measurement_spec and leading_indicator columns. Also flagged one blocker: Dedicated GPU provisioning lead time may impact early-quarter ramp — Vivek, can you confirm typical procurement lead time for reserved pools?

Attachment: okr_rubric_v2.csv (updated)

-Kimberly
Head of Product Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter Kickoff: Owners onboarding, OKR alignment, and QBR packet readiness

Kimberly —

Procurement note: for Dedicated reserved pools, typical lead time to provision committed GPU capacity with our cloud partners is ~4–6 weeks assuming no custom hardware constraints. If we need to guarantee early-quarter throughput for the objective, we should either: 

1) Move to a soft ramp (start with Hosted-compatible variants) while Dedicated provisioning completes, or
2) Expedite procurement (requires a procurement ticket + 2x expedited margin on the vendor side).

I’ll put a short note in the owners onboarding agenda about the options. If owners expect hard commitment day 1, flag it now so we can trigger procurement.

-Vivek
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha@fjordapps.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 13:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter Kickoff: Owners onboarding, OKR alignment, and QBR packet readiness

Appreciate the quick replies. Actions captured below — please treat as owners' checklist and mark done in the sheet by EOD Monday: 

1) Owners: Jonas to take Dedicated capacity objective (primary metric: %requests served by Dedicated / week). Kimberly to co-own rollout cadence.
2) Metrics spec: Kimberly to finalize measurement_spec and leading_indicator columns (done — thank you) and confirm percentile/sampling for latency metric.
3) Procurement: Vivek to confirm procurement path; if any objective requires day-1 Dedicated capacity, owners must flag that now.
4) QBR deck: I will fold Jonas' ask for Hosted vs Dedicated NRR breakout into Slide 6.
5) Onboarding meeting: Tuesday 10am PT — I'll send calendar invite with a 15-minute pre-read window. Link to Drive + packet in the invite.

Asha (FjordApps) — thanks for being on the thread. If your team has a customer slide or ask to include in the QBR packet, please send it to me by Monday EOD.

If there are no major objections, this thread will be our alignment anchor for owners signoff.

Thanks — Priya
